summary: Full stack testing complete. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (auth, roster CRUD, check-in variants incl. ill/high-soreness alerts, dashboard, checkins list, excel export, send-report). Frontend: check-in submission flow works end-to-end, coach login rejects wrong password, dashboard loads with summary cards + table + filters + search, roster add/remove, Excel download triggered (Wellness Report - 2026-09-18.xlsx), Email Report and Logout functional, protected route /coach/dashboard redirects to /coach when unauthenticated.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 433 lines still manageable; consider splitting Excel/email helpers into modules if it grows further.
notify_coach_alert email HTML is inline; move templates to a templates/ dir for maintainability.
startup seed uses ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env — good, but if missing values it will still create an empty-string user; add guard to skip seeding when env not set.
CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default) is invalid per spec; explicit origins should be set for production.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 35 athletes + coach user on startup. Tests create/delete TEST_-prefixed athletes and TEST_-named check-ins; check-in records not cleaned (harmless, dated today).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 backend endpoints validated via pytest. Frontend UI validated: check-in flow, /coach login (invalid+valid), dashboard summary+table+tabs+search, add/remove athlete, Excel download, Send Report, Logout, protected route redirect. Radix Select dropdowns need ~400ms wait after opening before clicking options. Data-testids are consistent with spec. If retesting summary card testids, wait for data.summary to load (not just squad-status-table which renders unconditionally).
